## Before requesting

- [ ] I searched existing issues for similar requests.
- [ ] I checked the README for existing features and known limitations.

## Problem or use case

Describe the notebook workflow you want to improve and what is difficult or
missing today. Include a concrete example using synthetic data if helpful.

## Proposed behavior

Describe how the feature should work from a user's perspective. If applicable,
include example commands, configuration, or expected output.
